status: All 28 assigned evaluation records manually reviewed; this is a subset assessment, not the complete 164-record experiment.
method: Every complete assembled response was read against its exact supplied prompt and changed-line chunk. Groundedness was adjudicated by concrete supported mechanisms and causal citations, not gold-text equality. Every stored production parse assessment was independently reproduced with parseReview. Audit rows and both nonempty diagnostic responses received a second independent manual read.

conventions.reason_grounded: True only for a supported concrete issue mechanism, independently of citation validity.
conventions.genuine_issue_detected: Requires a supported issue mechanism and a causally appropriate available changed-line citation.
conventions.claim_support: Assesses intelligible material factual claims separately from formatting and issue detection. No asserted claims gives null; true fragments alone do not establish an issue.
conventions.empty_responses: No reason: reason_grounded=false, genuine_issue_detected=false, all_material_claims_supported=null, all_findings_grounded=true vacuously, citation_causally_appropriate=null. A production-accepted empty review passes only a clean case.
conventions.malformed_presence: The production assessment's concern remains null when JSON is malformed; visible reasons and citation IDs are still manually assessed.
conventions.full_review_pass: Requires a complete accepted review with correct clean behavior or a supported harmful mechanism, causally valid citations, and all material claims supported.
conventions.scope_rules: Only applicable ancestor AGENTS rules shown in the prompt count; the sibling tools/docs rule is not shown in the archive cases.
